Since \(2014n=2000n+14n\), for \(n=5,\dots,49\) the last three digits are \(14n\).

Check small \(n\):
- \(n=5,\dots,11\): \(14n\) has divisor count not 16.
- \(n=12\): \(14n=168=2^3\cdot 3\cdot 7\), so it has \((3+1)(1+1)(1+1)=16\) factors.

Thus the smallest number is
\[
2014\cdot 12=24168.
\]

\[
\boxed{24168}
\]
